about: Seed for server/shareOfWorld.js: IMF WEO GDP (DataMapper) and World Bank stock-market capitalization. imf.org refuses Netlify build machines, so the module falls back to this file; it rewrites it whenever a live fetch brings different data.

imf.source: https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/{NGDPD,PPPGDP}: GDP, current prices, $bn at market exchange rates (usd) and PPP international $bn (ppp); WEOWORLD = world. [firstYear, [values…]]; years from projFrom (the vintage's year) on are WEO projections

wb.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/CM.MKT.LCAP.CD: market capitalization of listed domestic companies, current US$ bn; WLD = world (reporting markets only). [firstYear, [values…]]
